Here's a tightened version that stays polite but makes the ask clear:

Subject: Leaking kitchen sink, unit 132

Hi Gloria and Marcus,

I'm writing from unit 132. I paid my half of this month's $2,180 rent on the portal this morning, right when it opened, and I'd appreciate the same promptness on a repair.

The kitchen sink has been leaking under the cabinet for about a week, and there's now standing water. Could someone from maintenance take a look in the next few days? Please let me know when a visit is scheduled, and what time windows work so we can be home or leave access.

Thank you,
[your name]

Two notes: I changed "$1,090" to "my half of the $2,180" since your draft gave both numbers, but you can keep either. Also, if you have a photo of the puddle, attaching it helps the office prioritize. Want a shorter version for a text to Marcus?
